lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

A shepherd has X number of sheep. It takes him Y minutes per sheep to cut the wool. However, after every Z sheep, he must take the wool to the farm. This trip takes him W minutes (to the farm and back to the sheep).
Don't forget that if he still has sheep to shear, he must return to finish his job.
Once he finishes, he must go back to the farm anyway.
Input
Line1 : An Integer X for the number of sheep.
Line2 : An Integer Y for the number of minute per sheep.
Line3 : An Integer Z for the number of sheep before going to the farm.
Line4 : An Integer W for the number of minute for the trip to the farm or back to the sheeps
Output
Line1 : An integer for the duration of his work day, in minutes
Constraints
2 ≤ X ≤ 300
1 ≤ Y ≤ 300
1 ≤ Z ≤ 300
1 ≤ W ≤ 500
Example
Input
5
10
3
20
Output
110
